noticias.titular: Skubal shuts down Braves' bats, stakes Dodgers to 1-0 NLDS lead
noticias.texto: Tarik Skubal allowed one run in six dominant innings, retiring 15 straight batters in one stretch, and the Dodgers beat the Braves 5-3 on Saturday in Game 1 of their NL Division Series.

noticias.texto: Dodgers star Shohei Ohtani says the left knee and right biceps ailments that compromised him throughout the summer are issues he's "just going to have to manage" in the postseason.

noticias.texto: Dodgers ace Tarik Skubal will get the ball in Game 1 of the National League Division Series against the Atlanta Braves on Saturday, while the Braves were still sorting through their options.
